speaker: Doctor
text: That improvement is excellent, but the timing of new movement symptoms suggests a medication side effect. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That sounds like akathisia, a common side effect of antipsychotics, but we need to confirm the severity. Has this restlessness been present all day long or only during specific times, and have you tried to relieve it by moving around?
